data.name: Verdant Call
data.description: When entering a bloodrage, as a swift action you can animate nearby plants to aid you in combat, functioning as wilderness soldiers (UC), using your Charisma modifier instead of your Wisdom modifier. This effect lasts for as long as you continue bloodraging, regardless of the spell's normal duration.
